                exps_part=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
            # If not matching, treat as generic
            py.append(' '*indent+restore(line))
            continue
        if line.startswith('if'):
            m=re.match(r'if\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('while'):
            m=re.match(r'while\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='repeat':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('until'):
            m=re.match(r'until\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
                continue
        if line.startswith('function'):
            m=re.match(r'function\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', line)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1).split('.')[-1].split(':')[-1]
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('local function'):
            m=re.match(r'local\s+function\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((.*)\)', line)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1)
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('local'):
            rest=line[5:].strip()
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*const\s*>','',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*close\s*>','',rest)
            rest=restore(rest)
            rest=rest.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
            rest=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', rest)
            # Table constructor
            def repl_tbl(mm):
                inner=mm.group(1)
                parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
                new=[]
                idx=1
                for p in parts:
                    if '=' in p:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                            new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                        else:
                            new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                        idx+=1
                return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
            rest=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl, rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('return'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='break':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # Default
        line=restore(line)
        line=line.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
        line=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',line)
        line=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        # Table constructor
        def repl_tbl2(mm):
            inner=mm.group(1)
            parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
            new=[]
            idx=1
            for p in parts:
                if '=' in p:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                else:
                    new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                    idx+=1
            return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
        line=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl2, line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    return '\n'.join(py)

class LuaState:
    def __init__(self, arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=False, exe_path="./executable"):
        self.arg = arg_table
        self.lua_path = lua_path
        self.lua_cpath = lua_cpath
        self.warnings_on = warnings_on
        self.exe_path = exe_path
        self.globals = {}
        self.setup()

    def setup(self):
        self.globals['_G'] = self.globals
        self.globals['_VERSION'] = "Lua 5.5"
        self.globals['arg'] = self.arg
        def lua_print(*args):
            def tostring(v):
                if v is None:
                    return "nil"
                if v is True:
                    return "true"
                if v is False:
                    return "false"
                if isinstance(v, float):
                    return repr(v)
                return str(v)
            sys.stdout.write("\t".join(tostring(a) for a in args) + "\n")
        self.globals['print'] = lua_print
        import math as pymath
        m={}
        class Mod(dict):
            def __getattr__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return self[k]
                raise AttributeError(k)
        m['pi']=pymath.pi
        m['huge']=float('inf')
        m['abs']=abs
        m['sqrt']=pymath.sqrt
        m['floor']=pymath.floor
        m['ceil']=pymath.ceil
        m['sin']=pymath.sin
        m['cos']=pymath.cos
        m['tan']=pymath.tan
        m['asin']=pymath.asin
        m['acos']=pymath.acos
        m['atan']=pymath.atan
        m['exp']=pymath.exp
        m['log']=pymath.log
        m['max']=lambda *a: max(*a)
        m['min']=lambda *a: min(*a)
        m['type']=lambda x: 'integer' if isinstance(x,int) and not isinstance(x,bool) else 'float' if isinstance(x,float) else 'nil' if x is None else 'string' if isinstance(x,str) else 'table' if isinstance(x,dict) else 'function' if callable(x) else 'nil'
        m['tointeger']=lambda x: int(x) if isinstance(x,int) else int(float(x)) if isinstance(x,float) and float(x).is_integer() else None
        m['ult']=lambda a,b: (a % 2**64) < (b % 2**64)
        m['random']=lambda *a: random.random() if len(a)==0 else random.randint(a[0],a[1]) if len(a)==2 else int(random.random()*a[0])+1 if len(a)==1 else random.random()
        m['randomseed']=lambda *a: random.seed(*a) if a else random.seed()
        m['frexp']=pymath.frexp
        m['ldexp']=pymath.ldexp
        m['modf']=pymath.modf
        m['fmod']=pymath.fmod
        m['deg']=pymath.degrees
        m['rad']=pymath.radians
        m['maxinteger']=2**63-1
        m['mininteger']=-2**63
        self.globals['math']=Mod(m)

        s={}
        s['len']=lambda x: len(x)
        s['upper']=lambda x: x.upper()
        s['lower']=lambda x: x.lower()
        s['reverse']=lambda x: x[::-1]
        s['rep']=lambda x,n,sep="": (x+sep)*(n-1)+x if n>0 else ""
        s['sub']=lambda x,i,j=None: x[i-1:j] if j else x[i-1:]
        s['byte']=lambda x,i=1,j=None: tuple(ord(c) for c in x[i-1:j]) if j and isinstance(j,int) else ord(x[i-1]) if isinstance(x,str) and len(x)>=i else None
        s['char']=lambda *a: ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in a)
        s['find']=lambda x,y,i=1,plain=False: (lambda m: (m.start()+i, m.end()+i-1) if m else (None,))(re.search(re.escape(y) if plain else y, x[i-1:]))
        s['gsub']=lambda x,y,z,n=None: (re.sub(y,z,x), 1)
        s['format']=lambda fmt,*a: fmt % a
        self.globals['string']=Mod(s)

        t={}
        t['concat']=lambda tbl,sep="",i=1,j=None: sep.join(str(tbl[k]) for k in sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int)))
        t['insert']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['remove']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['sort']=lambda tbl,comp=None: None
        t['pack']=lambda *a: {**{i+1:v for i,v in enumerate(a)}, 'n': len(a)}
        def unpack(tbl,i=1,j=None):
            if isinstance(tbl, dict):
                keys=sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int))
                if not keys:
                    return ()
                start=i
                end=j if j is not None else max(keys)
                return tuple(tbl.get(k) for k in range(start, end+1))
            return ()
        t['unpack']=unpack
        t['move']=lambda a,f,e,t2=None,tt=None: (t2 or {} )
        t['create']=lambda narray,nrec=0: {}
        self.globals['table']=Mod(t)

        self.globals['package']={
            'path': self.lua_path,
            'cpath': self.lua_cpath,
            'config': "/\n;\n?\n!\n-\n",
            'loaded': {},
            'preload': {},
            'searchers': [lambda x: None]*4,
        }

        def make_warn(state):
            def warn(*args):
                if not args:
                    return
                first=args[0]
                if isinstance(first,str) and first.startswith('@'):
                    if first=='@on':
                        state.warnings_on=True
                    elif first=='@off':
                        state.warnings_on=False
                    return
                if state.warnings_on:
                    msg=''.join(str(a) for a in args)
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Lua warning: {msg}\n")
            return warn
        self.globals['warn']=make_warn(self)
        def lua_error(msg, level=1):
            raise LuaError(str(msg))
        self.globals['error']=lua_error
        self.globals['_VERSION']="Lua 5.5"

    def exec_chunk(self, code, chunkname):
        class ArgTable(dict):
            def get(self,k,d=None):
                return self[k] if k in self else d
            def __getitem__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return super().__getitem__(k)
                return None
        arg_obj=ArgTable(self.arg)
        def lua_len(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                n=0
                while (n+1) in x:
                    n+=1
                return n
            if isinstance(x, str):
                return len(x)
            return 0
        g={
            'print': self.globals['print'],
            'arg': arg_obj,
            'len': lua_len,
            'math': self.globals['math'],
            'string': self.globals['string'],
            'table': self.globals['table'],
            'package': self.globals['package'],
            'warn': self.globals['warn'],
            'error': self.globals['error'],
            'pairs': lambda t: t.items() if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'ipairs': lambda t: enumerate([t[k] for k in sorted(k for k in t.keys() if isinstance(k,int))], start=1) if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'type': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "boolean" if isinstance(x,bool) else "number" if isinstance(x,(int,float)) else "string" if isinstance(x,str) else "table" if isinstance(x,dict) else "function" if callable(x) else "nil",
            'tostring': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "true" if x is True else "false" if x is False else str(x),
            'tonumber': lambda x, base=10: (int(x, base) if isinstance(x,str) else int(x)) if isinstance(x,(int,str)) else None,
            '_VERSION': "Lua 5.5",
        }
        g.update(self.globals)
        class MathModule(dict):
            def __getattr__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return self[k]
                raise AttributeError(k)
        g['math']=MathModule(self.globals['math'])
        g['string']=MathModule(self.globals['string'])
        g['table']=MathModule(self.globals['table'])

        try:
            py_code=transpile_lua_to_python(code)
            # print("PY CODE:\n", py_code, file=sys.stderr)
            exec(py_code, g)
        except SyntaxError as e:
            near = e.text.strip() if e.text else "<eof>"
            sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: syntax error near '{near}'\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        except SystemExit:
            raise
        except LuaError as le:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: {le}\n")
            sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
            sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
            sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        except Exception as ex:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: {ex}\n")
            sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
            sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
            sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
            sys.exit(1)

def main():
    parsed=parse_args(sys.argv)
    if parsed['show_version']:
        sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
    lua_path=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_PATH", LUA_PATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_cpath=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_CPATH", LUA_CPATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_init=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_INIT", None)
    arg_table=build_arg_table(parsed)
    state=LuaState(arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=parsed['warnings_on'], exe_path=parsed['exe'])

    if lua_init is not None and lua_init!="":
        if lua_init.startswith("@"):
            fname=lua_init[1:]
            if fname=="":
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open : No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            try:
                with open(fname,'r') as f:
                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, fname)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {fname}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(lua_init, "LUA_INIT")
            except SystemExit:
                raise
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: LUA_INIT:1: {e}\n")
                sys.exit(1)

    for typ,val in parsed['actions']:
        if typ=='l':
            if '=' in val:
                gname, modname = val.split('=',1)
            else:
                gname=modname=val
            found=find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath)
            if not found:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: module '{modname}' not found:\n")
                if lua_path:
                    for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.','/'))}'\n")
                if lua_cpath:
                    for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.', '/'))}'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in function 'require'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            if modname not in BUILTIN_LIBS:
                if isinstance(found, str):
                    try:
                        with open(found,'r') as f:
                            content=f.read()
                            if content.startswith("#"):
                                content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                            state.exec_chunk(content, found)
                            state.globals[gname]=True
                    except:
                        state.globals[gname]=True
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
            else:
                if modname in state.globals:
                    state.globals[gname]=state.globals[modname]
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(val, "(command line)")
            except SystemExit:
                raise

    script=parsed['script']
    if script is None:
        if parsed['show_version'] and not parsed['interactive'] and len(parsed['actions'])==0:
            return
        if parsed['interactive']:
            sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
            buf=""
            while True:
                try:
                    sys.stdout.write("> " if buf=="" else ">> ")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                    line=sys.stdin.readline()
                    if line=="":
                        sys.stdout.write("\n")
                        break
                    buf+=line
                    try:
                        state.exec_chunk(buf, "stdin")
                        buf=""
                    except SystemExit:
                        raise
                    except Exception as e:
                        msg=str(e)
                        if "<eof>" in msg or "'end' expected" in msg:
                            continue
                        else:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"stdin:1: {msg}\n")
                            buf=""
                except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
                    break
            return
        else:
            data=sys.stdin.read()
            if not data:
                return
            if data.startswith("#"):
                data=data.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in data else ""
            state.exec_chunk(data, "stdin")
    else:
        if script=="-":
            data=sys.stdin.read()
            if data.startswith("#"):
                data=data.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in data else ""
            state.exec_chunk(data, "stdin")

                        try:

                            buf=""
                        except:

        else:

                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, script)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {script}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            if parsed['interactive']:
                sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")

import sys, os, re, math, random

def error_exit(msg, exe="./executable"):
    sys.stderr.write(msg+"\n")
    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
    sys.exit(1)

def parse_args(argv):
    exe=argv[0]
    args=argv[1:]
    show_version=False
    ignore_env=False
    warnings_on=False
    interactive=False
    actions=[]
    options_before=[]
    script=None
    script_args=[]
    stop_options=False
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        token=args[i]
        if script is not None:
            script_args=args[i:]
            break
        if not stop_options:
            if token=="--":
                stop_options=True
                options_before.append(token)
                i+=1
                continue
            if token=="-":
                script="-"
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            if token.startswith("-") and token not in ("-", "--"):
                if token=="-i":
                    interactive=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-v":
                    show_version=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-E":
                    ignore_env=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-W":
                    warnings_on=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-e"):
                    if token=="-e":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-e' needs argument", exe)
                        stat=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(stat)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        stat=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-l"):
                    if token=="-l":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-l' needs argument", exe)
                        mod=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(mod)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        mod=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{exe}: unrecognized option '{token}'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            else:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
        else:
            if script is None:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            else:
                script_args.append(token)
        i+=1
    return {
        'exe': exe,
        'show_version': show_version,
        'ignore_env': ignore_env,
        'warnings_on': warnings_on,
        'interactive': interactive,
        'actions': actions,
        'options_before': options_before,
        'script': script,
        'script_args': script_args,
    }

def process_path(env_val, default):
    if env_val is None:
        return default
    if env_val == "":
        return ""
    idx = env_val.find(";;")
    if idx == -1:
        return env_val
    prefix = env_val[:idx]
    suffix = env_val[idx+2:]
    result = prefix + ";" + default + ";" + suffix
    if prefix == "" and result.startswith(";"):
        result = result[1:]
    if suffix == "" and result.endswith(";"):
        result = result[:-1]
    return result

def get_env_path(ignore_env, name, default):
    if ignore_env:
        return default
    ver_name = name + "_5_5"
    ver_val = os.environ.get(ver_name)
    if ver_val is not None:
        val = ver_val
    else:
        val = os.environ.get(name)
    if name in ("LUA_PATH", "LUA_CPATH"):
        if val is None:
            return default
        return process_path(val, default)
    else:
        return val

def build_arg_table(parsed):
    exe = parsed['exe']
    script = parsed['script']
    before = parsed['options_before']
    s_args = parsed['script_args']
    arg = {}
    if script is not None:
        n = len(before)
        arg[-n-1] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[-n + i] = tok
        arg[0] = script
        for i, a in enumerate(s_args):
            arg[i+1] = a
    else:
        arg[0] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[i+1] = tok
    return arg

BUILTIN_LIBS = {'math','string','table','coroutine','os','io','debug','package','utf8'}

def find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath):
    if modname in BUILTIN_LIBS:
        return True
    if lua_path:
        for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    if lua_cpath:
        for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    return None

    strs=[]
    def save_str(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        strs.append(m.group(0))
        return ph
    def save_long(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        content=m.group(2)
        strs.append(repr(content))
        return ph

    # We'll first handle for numeric loops via regex that captures start,end,step, body, end

    # We'll use a helper to restore strings for regex groups

            ph=f"__STR{idx}__"
            s=s.replace(ph, st)
        return s

    # But we must not replace inside string placeholders (which are __STRn__)
    # So do after we protect strings, it's safe

    # Replace ; with newline
    code = code.replace(';','\n')

    # We'll now process lines that may contain multiple constructs

    # For simplicity, we will handle the entire code as a single string and use regex to convert known patterns to Python

    # First, handle for numeric: for var = start, end [, step] do ... end
    # We'll do iterative replacement for innermost loops

    # Define a function to convert for loop header to Python
    # We'll use regex with DOTALL to match across lines? For simplicity, handle single line and multi-line via newline insertion

    # Let's split into lines first to handle blocks

    lines = [l.strip() for l in code.split('\n') if l.strip()!='']

    # Expand lines that contain multiple keywords on same line
    expanded=[]
    for line in lines:
        # If line is like "for i=1,3 do print(i) end"
        # We'll attempt to split it into ["for i=1,3 do", "print(i)", "end"]
        # General approach: find "do", "then", "else", "end" as separate words and split

        # We'll use regex to split by keywords while keeping them

        # For this, we will insert newlines around keywords

        # Protect placeholders from being split? They don't contain keywords
        # Insert newlines around: do, then, else, elseif, end, function, if, for, while, repeat, until, break, return, local

        # Use word boundaries
        # We need to be careful: "for i=1,5 do print(i) end" -> we want to split into "for i=1,5 do", "print(i)", "end"
        # If we insert newline around "do", we get "for i=1,5 \ndo\n print(i) \nend\n" then split

        tmp = re.sub(r'\bdo\b', r'\ndo\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bthen\b', r'\nthen\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belse\b', r'\nelse\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belseif\b', r'\nelseif\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bend\b', r'\nend\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfunction\b', r'\nfunction\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bif\b', r'\nif\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfor\b', r'\nfor\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bwhile\b', r'\nwhile\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\brepeat\b', r'\nrepeat\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\buntil\b', r'\nuntil\n', tmp)

        for sub in tmp.split('\n'):
            sub=sub.strip()
            if sub:
                expanded.append(sub)

    lines=expanded

    py=[]
    indent=0

    i=0
    # Use while to handle cases where for header is split across two lines: "for" alone then assignment
    # After splitting, "for i=1,5 do" becomes ["for","i=1,5","print..."]? Actually our splitting of "for" alone will produce "for" then "i=1,5" as separate? Let's check: original "for i=1,5 do print(i) end" after replacing do and end: "for i=1,5 \ndo\n print(i) \nend\n" -> after further splitting for: "\nfor\n i=1,5 \ndo\n print(i) \nend\n" -> lines: "for","i=1,5","print(i)","end". So we have "for" alone, then assignment, then print, then end. We need to handle "for" followed by assignment.

    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        i+=1
        if not line:
            continue
        if line=='do' or line=='then':
            continue
        if line=='end':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line=='else':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            py.append(' '*indent+'else:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('elseif'):
            # line may be "elseif" alone then condition on next line?
            # After splitting, "elseif x>5 then" becomes ["elseif","x>5","print..."]? Let's attempt to handle both
            # If line is exactly "elseif", next line is condition?
            cond_part=line[6:].strip()
            if not cond_part:
                # Next line should be condition
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond_part=lines[i]
                    i+=1
            # cond_part may contain "then" already split? Actually then was split, so condition is separate
            # Remove trailing then if present
            cond_part=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond_part).strip()
            cond_part=restore(cond_part)
            cond_part=cond_part.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+')
            cond_part=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond_part)
            cond_part=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond_part)
            cond_part=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond_part)
            cond_part=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', cond_part)

            i+=1
            # assign_line could be "i=1,5" or "k,v in pairs(t)"

            # If line is "for i=1,5" (without do), we need to check if next token is do? But we already skipped do markers
            # So line should be like "for i=1,5" or "for i=1,5,2" or "for k,v in pairs(t)"

                var=m.group(1)
                start=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                end=restore(m.group(3).strip())
                step=m.group(4)
                # Translate operators in start/end
                def trans_e(e):
                    e = e.replace('~=', '!=')
                    e = e.replace('..','+')
                    e = e.replace('^','**')
                    e = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',e)
                    e = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',e)
                    e = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',e)
                    e = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', e)
                    return e
                start=trans_e(start)
                end=trans_e(end)
                if step:
                    step=trans_e(restore(step.strip()))
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1, {step}):')
                else:
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                indent+=1
                continue
            m=re.match(r'for\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                vars_part=m.group(1).strip()
                exps_part=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                exps_part=exps_part.replace('~=', '!=')
                exps_part=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
            # If not matching, treat as generic
            py.append(' '*indent+restore(line))
            continue
        if line.startswith('if'):
            m=re.match(r'if\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('while'):
            m=re.match(r'while\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='repeat':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('until'):
            m=re.match(r'until\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
                continue
        if line.startswith('function'):
            m=re.match(r'function\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', line)

                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')

                continue

            rest=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', rest)
            # Table constructor
            def repl_tbl(mm):
                inner=mm.group(1)
                parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
                new=[]
                idx=1
                for p in parts:
                    if '=' in p:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                            new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                        else:
                            new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                        idx+=1
                return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
            rest=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl, rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('return'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='break':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # Default
        line=restore(line)
        line=line.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
        line=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',line)
        line=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        # Table constructor
        def repl_tbl2(mm):
            inner=mm.group(1)
            parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
            new=[]
            idx=1
            for p in parts:
                if '=' in p:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                else:
                    new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                    idx+=1
            return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
        line=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl2, line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    return '\n'.join(py)

            arg[-n + i] = tok
        arg[0] = script
        for i, a in enumerate(s_args):
            arg[i+1] = a
    else:
        arg[0] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[i+1] = tok
    return arg

BUILTIN_LIBS = {'math','string','table','coroutine','os','io','debug','package','utf8'}

def find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath):
    if modname in BUILTIN_LIBS:
        return True
    if lua_path:
        for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    if lua_cpath:
        for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    return None

def transpile_lua_to_python(lua_code):
    strs=[]
    def save_str(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        strs.append(m.group(0))
        return ph
    def save_long(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        content=m.group(2)
        strs.append(repr(content))
        return ph

    code = re.sub(r'\[(=*)\[(.*?)\]\1\]', save_long, lua_code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    code = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'", save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r'--.*', '', code)

    # Replace ; with newline
    code = code.replace(';','\n')

    # Split into lines, then further split by keywords

    raw_lines = [l.strip() for l in code.split('\n') if l.strip()!='']
    flat=[]
    for rl in raw_lines:
        # Insert newlines around keywords
        tmp = rl
        # To avoid breaking for var assignment, we will split carefully
        # We will replace " do " etc with newline-wrapped
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bdo\b', '\nDO\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bthen\b', '\nTHEN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belse\b', '\nELSE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belseif\b', '\nELSEIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bend\b', '\nEND\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfunction\b', '\nFUNCTION\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bif\b', '\nIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfor\b', '\nFOR\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bwhile\b', '\nWHILE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\brepeat\b', '\nREPEAT\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\buntil\b', '\nUNTIL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\blocal\b', '\nLOCAL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\breturn\b', '\nRETURN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bbreak\b', '\nBREAK\n', tmp)
        for sub in tmp.split('\n'):
            sub=sub.strip()
            if sub:
                flat.append(sub)

    # Now process flat list with handling of headers that are split

    lines=flat
    py=[]
    indent=0

    def restore(s):
        for idx, st in enumerate(strs):
            ph=f"__STR{idx}__"
            s=s.replace(ph, st)
        return s

    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        i+=1
        if not line:
            continue
        # Uppercase markers
        if line=='DO' or line=='THEN':
            continue
        if line=='END':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line=='ELSE':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            py.append(' '*indent+'else:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line=='FOR':
            # Next line should contain assignment or in
            # Collect until we have a complete for header (contains = or in)
            # We may need to combine next lines until we have assignment
            header=""
            # If next line exists and contains "=" or "in", combine
            # Actually after splitting, FOR alone, then next line is like "i=1,5" or "k,v in pairs(t)"
            # So we take next line as header content
            if i < len(lines):
                header=lines[i]
                i+=1
                # If header is assignment like "i=1,5", we need to keep it as part of for
                # So combined for header is "for " + header
                combined = f"for {header}"
                # Now this combined should match for patterns
                m=re.match(r'for\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.+?),\s*(.+?)(?:,\s*(.+))?$', combined)
                if m:
                    var=m.group(1)
                    start=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                    end=restore(m.group(3).strip())
                    step=m.group(4)
                    def trans_e(e):
                        e = e.replace('~=', '!=')
                        e = e.replace('..','+')
                        e = e.replace('^','**')
                        e = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',e)
                        e = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',e)
                        e = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',e)
                        e = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', e)
                        return e
                    start=trans_e(start)
                    end=trans_e(end)
                    if step:
                        step=trans_e(restore(step.strip()))
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1, {step}):')
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                m=re.match(r'for\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', combined)
                if m:
                    vars_part=m.group(1).strip()
                    exps_part=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                    exps_part=exps_part.replace('~=', '!=')
                    exps_part=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',exps_part)
                    exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                # If not matching, treat as generic for?
                py.append(' '*indent+restore(combined))
            continue

        if line=='IF':
            if i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
                cond=restore(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue

        if line.startswith('IF '):
            m=re.match(r'IF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue

        if line.startswith('ELSEIF'):
            m=re.match(r'ELSEIF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=') 
                cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',cond)
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue

        if line.startswith('WHILE'):
            # Could be WHILE alone then condition
            cond=line[5:].strip()
            if not cond and i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
            cond=restore(cond)
            cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
            cond=cond.replace('~=', '!=')
            cond=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',cond)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
            indent+=1
            continue

        if line=='REPEAT':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue

        if line.startswith('UNTIL'):
            m=re.match(r'UNTIL\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
            else:
                # UNTIL alone, next line condition
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                    py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue

        if line.startswith('FUNCTION'):
            rest=line[8:].strip()
            rest=restore(rest)
            m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', rest)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1).split('.')[-1].split(':')[-1]
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
            continue

        if line.startswith('LOCAL'):
            # Could be LOCAL FUNCTION or LOCAL assignment or LOCAL alone
            if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('FUNCTION'):
                # LOCAL FUNCTION
                # Next line is FUNCTION header
                func_line=lines[i]
                i+=1
                # func_line after FUNCTION split: e.g., "myfunc(1,2)"
                m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((.*)\)', func_line)
                if m:
                    fname=m.group(1)
                    params=m.group(2)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                continue
            # LOCAL assignment
            # If line is exactly LOCAL, next line is assignment?
            rest=line[5:].strip()
            if not rest:
                if i < len(lines):
                    rest=lines[i]
                    i+=1
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*const\s*>','',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*close\s*>','',rest)
            rest=restore(rest)
            rest=rest.replace('~=', '!=').replace('..','+').replace('^','**')
            rest=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', rest)
            def repl_tbl(mm):
                inner=mm.group(1)
                parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
                new=[]
                idx=1
                for p in parts:
                    if '=' in p:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                            new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                        else:
                            new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                        idx+=1
                return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
            rest=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl, rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue

        if line.startswith('RETURN'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # Default
        line=restore(line)
        line=line.replace('~=', '!=')
        # Do not replace .. that is part of range? Already handled
        # Replace .. with + for concat, but not if it's in number? Simple
        # Avoid replacing ... which we already replaced earlier? Actually we replaced .. with + earlier, but now we have __ placeholders?
        # We'll handle
        line=re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',line)
        line=re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',line)
        line=re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def repl_tbl2(mm):
            inner=mm.group(1)
            parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
            new=[]
            idx=1
            for p in parts:
                if '=' in p:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                else:
                    new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                    idx+=1
            return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
        line=re.sub(r'\{([^}]*)\}', repl_tbl2, line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    return '\n'.join(py)

class LuaState:
    def __init__(self, arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=False, exe_path="./executable"):
        self.arg = arg_table
        self.lua_path = lua_path
        self.lua_cpath = lua_cpath
        self.warnings_on = warnings_on
        self.exe_path = exe_path
        self.globals = {}
        self.setup()

    def setup(self):
        self.globals['_G'] = self.globals
        self.globals['_VERSION'] = "Lua 5.5"
        self.globals['arg'] = self.arg
        def lua_print(*args):
            def tostring(v):
                if v is None:
                    return "nil"
                if v is True:
                    return "true"
                if v is False:
                    return "false"
                if isinstance(v, float):
                    return repr(v)
                return str(v)
            sys.stdout.write("\t".join(tostring(a) for a in args) + "\n")
        self.globals['print'] = lua_print
        import math as pymath
        m={}
        class Mod(dict):
            def __getattr__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return self[k]
                raise AttributeError(k)
        m['pi']=pymath.pi
        m['huge']=float('inf')
        m['abs']=abs
        m['sqrt']=pymath.sqrt
        m['floor']=pymath.floor
        m['ceil']=pymath.ceil
        m['sin']=pymath.sin
        m['cos']=pymath.cos
        m['tan']=pymath.tan
        m['asin']=pymath.asin
        m['acos']=pymath.acos
        m['atan']=pymath.atan
        m['exp']=pymath.exp
        m['log']=pymath.log
        m['max']=lambda *a: max(*a)
        m['min']=lambda *a: min(*a)
        m['type']=lambda x: 'integer' if isinstance(x,int) and not isinstance(x,bool) else 'float' if isinstance(x,float) else 'nil' if x is None else 'string' if isinstance(x,str) else 'table' if isinstance(x,dict) else 'function' if callable(x) else 'nil'
        m['tointeger']=lambda x: int(x) if isinstance(x,int) else int(float(x)) if isinstance(x,float) and float(x).is_integer() else None
        m['ult']=lambda a,b: (a % 2**64) < (b % 2**64)
        m['random']=lambda *a: random.random() if len(a)==0 else random.randint(a[0],a[1]) if len(a)==2 else int(random.random()*a[0])+1 if len(a)==1 else random.random()
        m['randomseed']=lambda *a: random.seed(*a) if a else random.seed()
        m['frexp']=pymath.frexp
        m['ldexp']=pymath.ldexp
        m['modf']=pymath.modf
        m['fmod']=pymath.fmod
        m['deg']=pymath.degrees
        m['rad']=pymath.radians
        m['maxinteger']=2**63-1
        m['mininteger']=-2**63
        self.globals['math']=Mod(m)
        s={}
        s['len']=lambda x: len(x)
        s['upper']=lambda x: x.upper()
        s['lower']=lambda x: x.lower()
        s['reverse']=lambda x: x[::-1]
        s['rep']=lambda x,n,sep="": (x+sep)*(n-1)+x if n>0 else ""
        s['sub']=lambda x,i,j=None: x[i-1:j] if j else x[i-1:]
        s['byte']=lambda x,i=1,j=None: tuple(ord(c) for c in x[i-1:j]) if j and isinstance(j,int) else ord(x[i-1]) if isinstance(x,str) and len(x)>=i else None
        s['char']=lambda *a: ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in a)
        s['find']=lambda x,y,i=1,plain=False: (lambda m: (m.start()+i, m.end()+i-1) if m else (None,))(re.search(re.escape(y) if plain else y, x[i-1:]))
        s['gsub']=lambda x,y,z,n=None: (re.sub(y,z,x), 1)
        s['format']=lambda fmt,*a: fmt % a
        self.globals['string']=Mod(s)
        t={}
        t['concat']=lambda tbl,sep="",i=1,j=None: sep.join(str(tbl[k]) for k in sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int)))
        t['insert']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['remove']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['sort']=lambda tbl,comp=None: None
        t['pack']=lambda *a: {**{i+1:v for i,v in enumerate(a)}, 'n': len(a)}
        def unpack(tbl,i=1,j=None):
            if isinstance(tbl, dict):
                keys=sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int))
                if not keys:
                    return ()
                start=i
                end=j if j is not None else max(keys)
                return tuple(tbl.get(k) for k in range(start, end+1))
            return ()
        t['unpack']=unpack
        t['move']=lambda a,f,e,t2=None,tt=None: (t2 or {} )
        t['create']=lambda narray,nrec=0: {}
        self.globals['table']=Mod(t)
        self.globals['package']={
            'path': self.lua_path,
            'cpath': self.lua_cpath,
            'config': "/\n;\n?\n!\n-\n",
            'loaded': {},
            'preload': {},
            'searchers': [lambda x: None]*4,
        }
        def make_warn(state):
            def warn(*args):
                if not args:
                    return
                first=args[0]
                if isinstance(first,str) and first.startswith('@'):
                    if first=='@on':
                        state.warnings_on=True
                    elif first=='@off':
                        state.warnings_on=False
                    return
                if state.warnings_on:
                    msg=''.join(str(a) for a in args)
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Lua warning: {msg}\n")
            return warn
        self.globals['warn']=make_warn(self)
        def lua_error(msg, level=1):
            raise LuaError(str(msg))
        self.globals['error']=lua_error
        self.globals['_VERSION']="Lua 5.5"

    def exec_chunk(self, code, chunkname):
        class ArgTable(dict):
            def get(self,k,d=None):
                return self[k] if k in self else d
            def __getitem__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return super().__getitem__(k)
                return None
        arg_obj=ArgTable(self.arg)
        def lua_len(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                n=0
                while (n+1) in x:
                    n+=1
                return n
            if isinstance(x, str):
                return len(x)
            return 0
        g={
            'print': self.globals['print'],
            'arg': arg_obj,
            'len': lua_len,
            'math': self.globals['math'],
            'string': self.globals['string'],
            'table': self.globals['table'],
            'package': self.globals['package'],
            'warn': self.globals['warn'],
            'error': self.globals['error'],
            'pairs': lambda t: t.items() if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'ipairs': lambda t: enumerate([t[k] for k in sorted(k for k in t.keys() if isinstance(k,int))], start=1) if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'type': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "boolean" if isinstance(x,bool) else "number" if isinstance(x,(int,float)) else "string" if isinstance(x,str) else "table" if isinstance(x,dict) else "function" if callable(x) else "nil",
            'tostring': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "true" if x is True else "false" if x is False else str(x),
            'tonumber': lambda x, base=10: (int(x, base) if isinstance(x,str) else int(x)) if isinstance(x,(int,str)) else None,
            '_VERSION': "Lua 5.5",
            'os': os,
            'sys': sys,
            'random': random,
            're': re,
        }
        g.update(self.globals)
        class MathModule(dict):
            def __getattr__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return self[k]
                raise AttributeError(k)
        g['math']=MathModule(self.globals['math'])
        g['string']=MathModule(self.globals['string'])
        g['table']=MathModule(self.globals['table'])
        try:
            py_code=transpile_lua_to_python(code)
            exec(py_code, g)
        except SyntaxError as e:
            near = e.text.strip() if e.text else "<eof>"
            sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: syntax error near '{near}'\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        except SystemExit:
            raise
        except Exception as ex:
            if isinstance(ex, LuaError):
                sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: {ex}\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: {ex}\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)

def main():
    parsed=parse_args(sys.argv)
    if parsed['show_version']:
        sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
    lua_path=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_PATH", LUA_PATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_cpath=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_CPATH", LUA_CPATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_init=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_INIT", None)
    arg_table=build_arg_table(parsed)
    state=LuaState(arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=parsed['warnings_on'], exe_path=parsed['exe'])
    if lua_init is not None and lua_init!="":
        if lua_init.startswith("@"):
            fname=lua_init[1:]
            if fname=="":
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open : No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            try:
                with open(fname,'r') as f:
                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, fname)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {fname}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(lua_init, "LUA_INIT")
            except SystemExit:
                raise
    for typ,val in parsed['actions']:
        if typ=='l':
            if '=' in val:
                gname, modname = val.split('=',1)
            else:
                gname=modname=val
            found=find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath)
            if not found:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: module '{modname}' not found:\n")
                if lua_path:
                    for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.','/'))}'\n")

def process_path(env_val, default):
    if env_val is None:
        return default
    if env_val == "":
        return ""
    idx = env_val.find(";;")
    if idx == -1:
        return env_val
    prefix = env_val[:idx]
    suffix = env_val[idx+2:]
    result = prefix + ";" + default + ";" + suffix
    if prefix == "" and result.startswith(";"):
        result = result[1:]
    if suffix == "" and result.endswith(";"):
        result = result[:-1]
    return result

def get_env_path(ignore_env, name, default):
    if ignore_env:
        return default
    ver_name = name + "_5_5"
    ver_val = os.environ.get(ver_name)
    if ver_val is not None:
        val = ver_val
    else:
        val = os.environ.get(name)
    if name in ("LUA_PATH", "LUA_CPATH"):
        if val is None:
            return default
        return process_path(val, default)
    else:
        return val

    exe = parsed['exe']

        arg[-n-1] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):

        arg[0] = script
        for i, a in enumerate(s_args):
            arg[i+1] = a
    else:

            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')

            def repl_tbl(mm):
                inner=mm.group(1)
                parts=[p.strip() for p in inner.split(',') if p.strip()!='']
                new=[]
                idx=1
                for p in parts:
                    if '=' in p:

        m['max']=lambda *a: max(*a)
        m['min']=lambda *a: min(*a)
        m['type']=lambda x: 'integer' if isinstance(x,int) and not isinstance(x,bool) else 'float' if isinstance(x,float) else 'nil' if x is None else 'string' if isinstance(x,str) else 'table' if isinstance(x,dict) else 'function' if callable(x) else 'nil'
        m['tointeger']=lambda x: int(x) if isinstance(x,int) else None
        m['ult']=lambda a,b: (a % 2**64) < (b % 2**64)
        m['random']=lambda *a: random.random() if len(a)==0 else random.randint(a[0],a[1]) if len(a)==2 else int(random.random()*a[0])+1 if len(a)==1 else random.random()
        m['randomseed']=lambda *a: random.seed(*a) if a else random.seed()
        m['frexp']=pymath.frexp
        m['ldexp']=pymath.ldexp
        m['modf']=pymath.modf
        m['fmod']=pymath.fmod
        m['deg']=pymath.degrees
        m['rad']=pymath.radians
        m['maxinteger']=2**63-1
        m['mininteger']=-2**63
        self.globals['math']=Mod(m)

        s={}
        s['len']=lambda x: len(x)
        s['upper']=lambda x: x.upper()
        s['lower']=lambda x: x.lower()
        s['reverse']=lambda x: x[::-1]
        s['rep']=lambda x,n,sep="": (x+sep)*(n-1)+x if n>0 else ""
        s['sub']=lambda x,i,j=None: x[i-1:j] if j else x[i-1:]
        s['byte']=lambda x,i=1,j=None: tuple(ord(c) for c in x[i-1:j]) if j and isinstance(j,int) else ord(x[i-1]) if isinstance(x,str) and len(x)>=i else None
        s['char']=lambda *a: ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in a)
        s['find']=lambda x,y,i=1,plain=False: (lambda m: (m.start()+i, m.end()+i-1) if m else (None,))(re.search(re.escape(y) if plain else y, x[i-1:]))
        s['gsub']=lambda x,y,z,n=None: (re.sub(y,z,x), 1)
        s['format']=lambda fmt,*a: fmt % a
        s['dump']=lambda f,strip=False: b'\x1bLua'
        s['pack']=lambda *a: b''
        s['unpack']=lambda *a: (None,)
        s['packsize']=lambda fmt: 0
        self.globals['string']=Mod(s)

        t={}
        t['concat']=lambda tbl,sep="",i=1,j=None: sep.join(str(tbl[k]) for k in sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int)))
        t['insert']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['remove']=lambda tbl,*a: None
        t['sort']=lambda tbl,comp=None: None
        t['pack']=lambda *a: {**{i+1:v for i,v in enumerate(a)}, 'n': len(a)}
        def unpack(tbl,i=1,j=None):
            if isinstance(tbl, dict):
                keys=sorted(k for k in tbl.keys() if isinstance(k,int))
                if not keys:
                    return ()
                start=i
                end=j if j is not None else max(keys)
                return tuple(tbl.get(k) for k in range(start, end+1))
            return ()
        t['unpack']=unpack
        t['move']=lambda a,f,e,t2=None,tt=None: (t2 or {} )
        t['create']=lambda narray,nrec=0: {}
        self.globals['table']=Mod(t)

        self.globals['package']=Mod({
            'path': self.lua_path,
            'cpath': self.lua_cpath,
            'config': "/\n;\n?\n!\n-\n",
            'loaded': {},
            'preload': {},
            'searchers': [lambda x: None]*4,
        })

        def make_warn(state):
            def warn(*args):
                if not args:
                    return
                first=args[0]
                if isinstance(first,str) and first.startswith('@'):
                    if first=='@on':
                        state.warnings_on=True
                    elif first=='@off':
                        state.warnings_on=False
                    return
                if state.warnings_on:
                    msg=''.join(str(a) for a in args)
                    sys.stderr.write(f"Lua warning: {msg}\n")
            return warn
        self.globals['warn']=make_warn(self)
        def lua_error(msg, level=1):
            raise LuaError(str(msg))
        self.globals['error']=lua_error
        self.globals['_VERSION']="Lua 5.5"

    def exec_chunk(self, code, chunkname):
        class ArgTable(dict):
            def get(self,k,d=None):
                return self[k] if k in self else d
            def __getitem__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return super().__getitem__(k)
                return None
        arg_obj=ArgTable(self.arg)
        def lua_len(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                n=0
                while (n+1) in x:
                    n+=1
                return n
            if isinstance(x, str):
                return len(x)
            return 0
        g={
            'print': self.globals['print'],
            'arg': arg_obj,
            'len': lua_len,
            'math': self.globals['math'],
            'string': self.globals['string'],
            'table': self.globals['table'],
            'package': self.globals['package'],
            'warn': self.globals['warn'],
            'error': self.globals['error'],
            'pairs': lambda t: t.items() if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'ipairs': lambda t: enumerate([t[k] for k in sorted(k for k in t.keys() if isinstance(k,int))], start=1) if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'type': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "boolean" if isinstance(x,bool) else "number" if isinstance(x,(int,float)) else "string" if isinstance(x,str) else "table" if isinstance(x,dict) else "function" if callable(x) else "nil",
            'tostring': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "true" if x is True else "false" if x is False else str(x),
            'tonumber': lambda x, base=10: (int(x, base) if isinstance(x,str) else int(x)) if isinstance(x,(int,str)) else None,
            '_VERSION': "Lua 5.5",
        }
        g.update(self.globals)
        class Mod(dict):
            def __getattr__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return self[k]
                raise AttributeError(k)
        g['math']=Mod(self.globals['math'])
        g['string']=Mod(self.globals['string'])
        g['table']=Mod(self.globals['table'])
        g['package']=Mod(self.globals['package'])

        try:
            py_code=transpile_lua_to_python(code)
            exec(py_code, g)
        except SyntaxError as e:
            near = e.text.strip() if e.text else "<eof>"
            sys.stderr.write(f"{chunkname}:1: syntax error near '{near}'\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        except SystemExit:
            raise
        except Exception as ex:
            # Check if ex is from error()
            # For error('oops'), we raise LuaError which we handle
            if isinstance(ex, LuaError):
                sys.stderr.write(f"{self.exe_path}: {chunkname}:1: {ex}\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t[C]: in global 'error'\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            else:
                # Generic runtime error
                # If it's AttributeError for math path etc, produce Lua-like message?
                # For package.path case: original prints value, not error. For our case where package.path access fails as dict, we had error.
                # Now with Mod, it should work.

                # For other errors, produce Lua traceback
                sys.stderr.write(f"{self.exe_path}: {chunkname}:1: {ex}\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)

def main():
    parsed=parse_args(sys.argv)
    if parsed['show_version']:
        sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
    lua_path=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_PATH", LUA_PATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_cpath=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_CPATH", LUA_CPATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_init=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_INIT", None)
    arg_table=build_arg_table(parsed)
    state=LuaState(arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=parsed['warnings_on'], exe_path=parsed['exe'])

    if lua_init is not None and lua_init!="":
        if lua_init.startswith("@"):
            fname=lua_init[1:]
            if fname=="":
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open : No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            try:
                with open(fname,'r') as f:
                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, fname)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {fname}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(lua_init, "LUA_INIT")
            except SystemExit:
                raise

    for typ,val in parsed['actions']:
        if typ=='l':
            if '=' in val:
                gname, modname = val.split('=',1)
            else:
                gname=modname=val
            found=find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath)
            if not found:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: module '{modname}' not found:\n")
                if lua_path:
                    for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.','/'))}'\n")
                if lua_cpath:
                    for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.', '/'))}'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in function 'require'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            if modname not in BUILTIN_LIBS:
                if isinstance(found, str):
                    try:
                        with open(found,'r') as f:
                            content=f.read()
                            if content.startswith("#"):
                                content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                            state.exec_chunk(content, found)
                            state.globals[gname]=True
                    except:
                        state.globals[gname]=True
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
            else:
                if modname in state.globals:
                    state.globals[gname]=state.globals[modname]
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(val, "(command line)")
            except SystemExit:
                raise

    script=parsed['script']
    if script is None:
        if parsed['show_version'] and not parsed['interactive'] and len(parsed['actions'])==0:
            return
        if parsed['interactive']:
            sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
            buf=""
            while True:
                try:
                    sys.stdout.write("> " if buf=="" else ">> ")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                    line=sys.stdin.readline()
                    if line=="":
                        sys.stdout.write("\n")
                        break
                    buf+=line
                    try:
                        state.exec_chunk(buf, "stdin")
                        buf=""
                    except SystemExit:
                        raise
                    except Exception as e:
                        msg=str(e)
                        if "<eof>" in msg or "'end' expected" in msg:
                            continue
                        else:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"stdin:1: {msg}\n")
                            buf=""
                except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
                    break
            return
        else:
            data=sys.stdin.read()
            if not data:
                return
            if data.startswith("#"):
                data=data.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in data else ""
            state.exec_chunk(data, "stdin")
    else:
        if script=="-":
            data=sys.stdin.read()
            if data.startswith("#"):
                data=data.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in data else ""
            state.exec_chunk(data, "stdin")
            if parsed['interactive']:
                sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
                buf=""
                while True:
                    try:
                        sys.stdout.write("> " if buf=="" else ">> ")
                        sys.stdout.flush()
                        line=sys.stdin.readline()
                        if line=="":
                            sys.stdout.write("\n")
                            break
                        buf+=line
                        try:
                            state.exec_chunk(buf, "stdin")
                            buf=""
                        except:
                            continue
                    except:
                        break
        else:
            try:
                with open(script,'r') as f:
                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, script)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {script}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            if parsed['interactive']:
                sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
                buf=""
                while True:
                    try:
                        sys.stdout.write("> " if buf=="" else ">> ")
                        sys.stdout.flush()
                        line=sys.stdin.readline()
                        if line=="":
                            sys.stdout.write("\n")
                            break
                        buf+=line
                        try:
                            state.exec_chunk(buf, "stdin")
                            buf=""
                        except:
                            continue
                    except:
                        break

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
