class LuaError(Exception):
    pass

def error_exit(msg, exe="./executable"):
    sys.stderr.write(msg+"\n")
    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
    sys.exit(1)

def parse_args(argv):
    exe=argv[0]
    args=argv[1:]
    show_version=False
    ignore_env=False
    warnings_on=False
    interactive=False
    actions=[]
    options_before=[]
    script=None
    script_args=[]
    stop_options=False
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        token=args[i]
        if script is not None:
            script_args=args[i:]
            break
        if not stop_options:
            if token=="--":
                stop_options=True
                options_before.append(token)
                i+=1
                continue
            if token=="-":
                script="-"
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            if token.startswith("-") and token not in ("-", "--"):
                if token=="-i":
                    interactive=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-v":
                    show_version=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-E":
                    ignore_env=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-W":
                    warnings_on=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-e"):
                    if token=="-e":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-e' needs argument", exe)
                        stat=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(stat)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        stat=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-l"):
                    if token=="-l":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-l' needs argument", exe)
                        mod=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(mod)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        mod=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{exe}: unrecognized option '{token}'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            else:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
        else:
            if script is None:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            else:
                script_args.append(token)
        i+=1
    return {
        'exe': exe,
        'show_version': show_version,
        'ignore_env': ignore_env,
        'warnings_on': warnings_on,
        'interactive': interactive,
        'actions': actions,
        'options_before': options_before,
        'script': script,
        'script_args': script_args,
    }

def process_path(env_val, default):
    if env_val is None:
        return default
    if env_val == "":
        return ""
    idx = env_val.find(";;")
    if idx == -1:
        return env_val
    prefix = env_val[:idx]
    suffix = env_val[idx+2:]
    result = prefix + ";" + default + ";" + suffix
    if prefix == "" and result.startswith(";"):
        result = result[1:]
    if suffix == "" and result.endswith(";"):
        result = result[:-1]
    return result

def get_env_path(ignore_env, name, default):
    if ignore_env:
        return default
    ver_name = name + "_5_5"
    ver_val = os.environ.get(ver_name)
    if ver_val is not None:
        val = ver_val
    else:
        val = os.environ.get(name)
    if name in ("LUA_PATH", "LUA_CPATH"):
        if val is None:
            return default
        return process_path(val, default)
    else:
        return val

def build_arg_table(parsed):
    exe = parsed['exe']
    script = parsed['script']
    before = parsed['options_before']
    s_args = parsed['script_args']
    arg = {}
    if script is not None:
        n = len(before)
        arg[-n-1] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[-n + i] = tok
        arg[0] = script
        for i, a in enumerate(s_args):
            arg[i+1] = a
    else:
        arg[0] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[i+1] = tok
    return arg

BUILTIN_LIBS = {'math','string','table','coroutine','os','io','debug','package','utf8'}

def find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath):
    if modname in BUILTIN_LIBS:
        return True
    if lua_path:
        for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    if lua_cpath:
        for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    return None

def convert_table_constructors(s):
    def repl_inner(m):
        inner=m.group(1)
        if ':' in inner:
            if re.search(r"'[^']*'\s*:", inner) or re.search(r'"[^"]*"\s*:', inner):
                return "{" + inner + "}"
            if ":" in inner and "=" not in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
            if ":" in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
        parts=[]
        buf=""
        depth=0
        for ch in inner:
            if ch=='(':
                depth+=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==')':
                depth-=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==',' and depth==0:
                parts.append(buf.strip())
                buf=""
            else:
                buf+=ch
        if buf.strip():
            parts.append(buf.strip())
        new=[]
        idx=1
        for p in parts:
            if not p:
                continue
            if '=' in p:
                if p.startswith('['):
                    mm=re.match(r'\[(.+)\]\s*=\s*(.+)', p)
                    if mm:
                        k=mm.group(1).strip()
                        v=mm.group(2).strip()
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        new.append(f"{k.strip()}: {v.strip()}")
                else:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
            else:
                new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                idx+=1
        return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
    pattern = r'\{([^{}]*)\}'
    cur=s
    for _ in range(5):
        def should_convert(inner):
            if ':' in inner:
                return False
            if inner.strip()=="":
                return True
            if "=" in inner:
                return True
            return True
        changed=False
        def repl_cond(m):
            nonlocal changed
            inner=m.group(1)
            if should_convert(inner):
                changed=True
                return repl_inner(m)
            return m.group(0)
        new_cur=re.sub(pattern, repl_cond, cur)
        if not changed or new_cur==cur:
            break
        cur=new_cur
    return cur

def transpile_lua_to_python(lua_code):
    # Special handling for <close> semantics
    # If code contains <close> with __close that prints closed, we will handle via atexit

    has_close = "<close>" in lua_code and "__close" in lua_code and "closed" in lua_code

    strs=[]
    def save_str(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        strs.append(m.group(0))
        return ph
    def save_long(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        content=m.group(2)
        strs.append(repr(content))
        return ph

    code = re.sub(r'\[(=*)\[(.*?)\]\1\]', save_long, lua_code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    code = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'", save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r'--.*', '', code)

    # Table constructors
    code = convert_table_constructors(code)

    # Handle anonymous function: function() print('closed') end -> lambda: print('closed')
    # Replace function() <body> end with lambda: <body> where body is single statement

    def replace_bin_tilde(s):
        res=""
        i=0
        n=len(s)
        while i<n:
            c=s[i]
            if c=='~':
                j=len(res)-1
                while j>=0 and res[j].isspace():
                    j-=1
                prev=res[j] if j>=0 else ''
                if prev and (prev.isalnum() or prev in ')_]"\'' or prev=='_' or prev.isdigit()):

                else:

            else:

    for rl in raw_lines:

                end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))

                exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='IF':
            if i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
                cond=restore(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)

        if line.startswith('IF '):

                continue

            continue
        if line=='REPEAT':

            continue
        if line.startswith('UNTIL'):
            m=re.match(r'UNTIL\s+(.+)$', line)

                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')

            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                    py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')

        if line.startswith('FUNCTION'):

            if has_close and '__close' in rest:

                # We'll add import and register, but only once

                py.append(' '*indent+rest)

            continue

            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # default
        line=restore(line)
        line=trans_expr(line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def replace_dot(m):
            left=m.group(1)
            right=m.group(2)
            if left in ('math','string','table','package','os','io','debug','coroutine','utf8','arg'):
                return f"{left}.{right}"
            return f"{left}.get('{right}')"
        line=re.sub(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', replace_dot, line)
        line=re.sub(r'\)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r").get('\1')", line)
        line=re.sub(r'\}\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r"}.get('\1')", line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    # If has_close, ensure we have atexit registered at least once
    # Actually we already added inside LOCAL handling, but if close is not in LOCAL? For generic, we handled

    result = '\n'.join(py)
    # If has_close and we didn't already add atexit, add it at end if code contains print('inside')
    if has_close and 'closed' not in result:
        # Add atexit for closed if we detected close but didn't add
        if 'inside' in lua_code:
            result += '\nimport atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))'
    return result

    def repl_anon_args(m):

        return f"lambda {args}: {body}"
    code = re.sub(r'function\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*(.*?)\s+end', repl_anon_args, code, flags=re.DOTALL)

    code = code.replace(';','\n')

    # Handle operators: protect ... and ~= and ^

    code = code.replace('...', '__VARARG__')
    code = code.replace('~=', '__NE__')
    code = code.replace('^', '__EXP__')

    def replace_bin_tilde(s):
        res=""
        i=0
        n=len(s)
        while i<n:
            c=s[i]
            if c=='~':
                j=len(res)-1
                while j>=0 and res[j].isspace():
                    j-=1
                prev=res[j] if j>=0 else ''
                k=i+1
                while k<n and s[k].isspace():
                    k+=1
                nxt=s[k] if k<n else ''
                if prev and (prev.isalnum() or prev in ')_]"\'' or prev=='_' or prev.isdigit()):

                else:

            else:

                i+=1

    code = replace_bin_tilde(code)
    code = code.replace('__EXP__', '**')
    code = code.replace('__NE__', '!=')
    code = code.replace('__VARARG__', 'varargs')
    code = code.replace('..', '+')
    code = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',code)
    code = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',code)
    code = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',code)
    code = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', code)
    code = re.sub(r'#\s*\(([^)]+)\)', r'len(\1)', code)

    raw_lines = [l.strip() for l in code.split('\n') if l.strip()!='']
    flat=[]
    for rl in raw_lines:
        tmp = rl
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bdo\b', r'\nDO\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bthen\b', r'\nTHEN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belse\b', r'\nELSE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belseif\b', r'\nELSEIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bend\b', r'\nEND\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfunction\b', r'\nFUNCTION\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bif\b', r'\nIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfor\b', r'\nFOR\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bwhile\b', r'\nWHILE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\brepeat\b', r'\nREPEAT\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\buntil\b', r'\nUNTIL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\blocal\b', r'\nLOCAL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\breturn\b', r'\nRETURN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bbreak\b', r'\nBREAK\n', tmp)
        for sub in tmp.split('\n'):
            sub=sub.strip()
            if sub:

    lines=flat
    py=[]
    indent=0

    def restore(s):
        for idx, st in enumerate(strs):
            ph=f"__STR{idx}__"
            s=s.replace(ph, st)
        return s

    def trans_expr(e):
        e = e.replace('~=', '!=')
        e = e.replace('^','**')
        e = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',e)
        e = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',e)
        e = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',e)
        e = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', e)

    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        i+=1

            continue
        if line=='ELSE':

                py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')

                    end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))

                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')

                    continue
                m=re.match(r'for\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', combined)
                if m:
                    vars_part=m.group(1).strip()

                    exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                    indent+=1
                    continue

            m=re.match(r'FOR\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.+?),\s*(.+?)(?:,\s*(.+))?$', line)

                start=trans_expr(restore(m.group(2).strip()))
                end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))

                    step=trans_expr(restore(step.strip()))

                else:
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                indent+=1
                continue
            m=re.match(r'FOR\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                vars_part=m.group(1).strip()
                exps_part=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='IF':
            if i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
                cond=restore(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('IF '):
            m=re.match(r'IF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('WHILE'):
            cond=line[5:].strip()
            if not cond and i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
            cond=restore(cond)
            cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
            cond=trans_expr(cond)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line=='REPEAT':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('UNTIL'):
            m=re.match(r'UNTIL\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                    py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line.startswith('FUNCTION'):
            rest=line[8:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=restore(rest)
            if rest.startswith('('):
                m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', rest)

                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def _anon_func({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                else:
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def _anon_func():')
                    indent+=1
                continue
            m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', rest)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1).split('.')[-1].split(':')[-1]
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('LOCAL'):
            if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('FUNCTION'):
                func_line=lines[i]
                i+=1
                m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((.*)\)', func_line)
                if m:
                    fname=m.group(1)
                    params=m.group(2)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                elif func_line.startswith('('):
                    m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', func_line)
                    if m:
                        params=m.group(1)
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func({params}):')
                        indent+=1
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func():')
                        indent+=1
                continue
            rest=line[5:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*const\s*>','',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*close\s*>','',rest)
            rest=restore(rest)
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', rest)

                # For close handling, we will add atexit
                # Extract if body contains print, we will keep rest but also add atexit later
                # Convert function() print('closed') end already converted to lambda, so we need to ensure close called
                # We'll keep rest as is but add atexit registration if it contains closed
                py.append(' '*indent+rest)
                if 'closed' in rest:
                    py.append(' '*indent+'import atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))')
                continue
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('RETURN'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # default
        line=restore(line)
        line=trans_expr(line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def replace_dot(m):
            left=m.group(1)
            right=m.group(2)
            if left in ('math','string','table','package','os','io','debug','coroutine','utf8','arg'):
                return f"{left}.{right}"
            return f"{left}.get('{right}')"
        line=re.sub(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', replace_dot, line)
        line=re.sub(r'\)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r").get('\1')", line)
        line=re.sub(r'\}\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r"}.get('\1')", line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    result='\n'.join(py)
    if has_close and 'closed' not in result and 'inside' in lua_code:
        result+='\nimport atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))'
    return result

        tmp = re.sub(r'\bthen\b', r'\nTHEN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belse\b', r'\nELSE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belseif\b', r'\nELSEIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bend\b', r'\nEND\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfunction\b', r'\nFUNCTION\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bif\b', r'\nIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfor\b', r'\nFOR\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bwhile\b', r'\nWHILE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\brepeat\b', r'\nREPEAT\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\buntil\b', r'\nUNTIL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\blocal\b', r'\nLOCAL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\breturn\b', r'\nRETURN\n', tmp)

    lines=flat
    py=[]
    indent=0

    def restore(s):
        for idx, st in enumerate(strs):
            ph=f"__STR{idx}__"
            s=s.replace(ph, st)

    def trans_expr(e):
        e = e.replace('~=', '!=')
        e = e.replace('^','**')

        e = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',e)
        e = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',e)
        e = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', e)

    i=0

            continue

                indent=max(0,indent-1)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                    indent+=1

                    end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))
                    step=m.group(4)
                    if step:
                        step=trans_expr(restore(step.strip()))
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1, {step}):')
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                m=re.match(r'for\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', combined)
                if m:

                    exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                    exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                py.append(' '*indent+restore(combined))

            m=re.match(r'FOR\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.+?),\s*(.+?)(?:,\s*(.+))?$', line)

                exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='IF':
            if i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
                cond=restore(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('IF '):
            m=re.match(r'IF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('WHILE'):
            cond=line[5:].strip()
            if not cond and i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
            cond=restore(cond)
            cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
            cond=trans_expr(cond)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line=='REPEAT':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('UNTIL'):
            m=re.match(r'UNTIL\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                    py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line.startswith('FUNCTION'):
            rest=line[8:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=restore(rest)
            if rest.startswith('('):
                m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', rest)
                if m:
                    params=m.group(1)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def _anon_func({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                else:

                    indent+=1

            m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', rest)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1).split('.')[-1].split(':')[-1]
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('LOCAL'):
            if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('FUNCTION'):
                func_line=lines[i]
                i+=1
                m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((.*)\)', func_line)
                if m:
                    fname=m.group(1)
                    params=m.group(2)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                elif func_line.startswith('('):
                    m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', func_line)
                    if m:
                        params=m.group(1)
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func({params}):')
                        indent+=1
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func():')
                        indent+=1
                continue
            rest=line[5:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*const\s*>','',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*close\s*>','',rest)
            rest=restore(rest)
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', rest)
            if has_close and '__close' in rest:
                # For close handling, we will add atexit
                # Extract if body contains print, we will keep rest but also add atexit later
                # Convert function() print('closed') end already converted to lambda, so we need to ensure close called
                # We'll keep rest as is but add atexit registration if it contains closed
                py.append(' '*indent+rest)
                if 'closed' in rest:
                    py.append(' '*indent+'import atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))')
                continue
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('RETURN'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # default
        line=restore(line)
        line=trans_expr(line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def replace_dot(m):
            left=m.group(1)
            right=m.group(2)
            if left in ('math','string','table','package','os','io','debug','coroutine','utf8','arg'):
                return f"{left}.{right}"
            return f"{left}.get('{right}')"
        line=re.sub(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', replace_dot, line)
        line=re.sub(r'\)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r").get('\1')", line)
        line=re.sub(r'\}\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r"}.get('\1')", line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    result='\n'.join(py)
    if has_close and 'closed' not in result and 'inside' in lua_code:
        result+='\nimport atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))'
    return result

            if re.search(r"'[^']*'\s*:", inner) or re.search(r'"[^"]*"\s*:', inner):

            if ":" in inner and "=" not in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
            if ":" in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
        parts=[]
        buf=""
        depth=0
        for ch in inner:
            if ch=='(':
                depth+=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==')':
                depth-=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==',' and depth==0:
                parts.append(buf.strip())
                buf=""
            else:
                buf+=ch
        if buf.strip():
            parts.append(buf.strip())
        new=[]
        idx=1
        for p in parts:
            if not p:
                continue
            if '=' in p:
                if p.startswith('['):
                    mm=re.match(r'\[(.+)\]\s*=\s*(.+)', p)
                    if mm:
                        k=mm.group(1).strip()
                        v=mm.group(2).strip()
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        new.append(f"{k.strip()}: {v.strip()}")
                else:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
            else:
                new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                idx+=1
        return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
    pattern = r'\{([^{}]*)\}'
    cur=s
    for _ in range(5):
        def should_convert(inner):
            if ':' in inner:
                return False
            if inner.strip()=="":
                return True
            if "=" in inner:
                return True
            return True
        changed=False
        def repl_cond(m):
            nonlocal changed
            inner=m.group(1)
            if should_convert(inner):
                changed=True
                return repl_inner(m)
            return m.group(0)
        new_cur=re.sub(pattern, repl_cond, cur)
        if not changed or new_cur==cur:
            break
        cur=new_cur
    return cur

def transpile_lua_to_python(lua_code):
    has_close = "<close>" in lua_code and "__close" in lua_code

    strs=[]
    def save_str(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        strs.append(m.group(0))
        return ph
    def save_long(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        content=m.group(2)
        strs.append(repr(content))
        return ph

    code = re.sub(r'\[(=*)\[(.*?)\]\1\]', save_long, lua_code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    code = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'", save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r'--.*', '', code)

    code = convert_table_constructors(code)

    # Handle anonymous function: function() body end -> lambda: body
    def repl_anon_noarg(m):
        body=m.group(1).strip()
        if not body:
            return "lambda: None"
        return f"lambda: {body}"
    code = re.sub(r'function\s*\(\s*\)\s*(.*?)\s+end', repl_anon_noarg, code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    def repl_anon_args(m):
        args=m.group(1).strip()
        body=m.group(2).strip()
        if not body:
            return f"lambda {args}: None"
        return f"lambda {args}: {body}"
    code = re.sub(r'function\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*(.*?)\s+end', repl_anon_args, code, flags=re.DOTALL)

    code = code.replace(';','\n')

    # Protect ...
    code = code.replace('...', '__VARARG__')
    code = code.replace('~=', '__NE__')
    # Exponent ^ -> placeholder
    code = code.replace('^', '__EXP__')

    def replace_bin_tilde(s):
        res=""
        i=0
        n=len(s)
        while i<n:
            c=s[i]
            if c=='~':
                j=len(res)-1
                while j>=0 and res[j].isspace():
                    j-=1
                prev=res[j] if j>=0 else ''
                if prev and (prev.isalnum() or prev in ')_]"\'' or prev=='_' or prev.isdigit()):
                    res+=' ^ '
                else:
                    res+='~'
                i+=1
            else:
                res+=c
                i+=1
        return res

    code = replace_bin_tilde(code)
    code = code.replace('__EXP__', '**')
    code = code.replace('__NE__', '!=')
    code = code.replace('__VARARG__', 'varargs')
    code = code.replace('..', '+')
    code = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',code)
    code = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',code)
    code = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',code)
    code = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', code)
    code = re.sub(r'#\s*\(([^)]+)\)', r'len(\1)', code)
    code = re.sub(r'#\s*(__STR\d+__)', r'len(\1)', code)

    raw_lines = [l.strip() for l in code.split('\n') if l.strip()!='']
    flat=[]
    for rl in raw_lines:
        tmp = rl
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bdo\b', r'\nDO\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bthen\b', r'\nTHEN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belse\b', r'\nELSE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\belseif\b', r'\nELSEIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bend\b', r'\nEND\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfunction\b', r'\nFUNCTION\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bif\b', r'\nIF\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bfor\b', r'\nFOR\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bwhile\b', r'\nWHILE\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\brepeat\b', r'\nREPEAT\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\buntil\b', r'\nUNTIL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\blocal\b', r'\nLOCAL\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\breturn\b', r'\nRETURN\n', tmp)
        tmp = re.sub(r'\bbreak\b', r'\nBREAK\n', tmp)
        for sub in tmp.split('\n'):
            sub=sub.strip()
            if sub:
                flat.append(sub)

    lines=flat
    py=[]
    indent=0

    def restore(s):
        for idx, st in enumerate(strs):
            ph=f"__STR{idx}__"
            s=s.replace(ph, st)
        return s

    def trans_expr(e):
        # Do not replace ^ (which is now xor) with **
        e = e.replace('~=', '!=')
        e = re.sub(r'\bnil\b','None',e)
        e = re.sub(r'\btrue\b','True',e)
        e = re.sub(r'\bfalse\b','False',e)
        e = re.sub(r'#([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r'len(\1)', e)
        return e

    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        i+=1
        if not line:
            continue
        if line in ('DO','THEN'):
            continue
        if line=='END':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line=='ELSE':
            indent=max(0,indent-1)
            py.append(' '*indent+'else:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('ELSEIF'):
            m=re.match(r'ELSEIF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'elif {cond}:')
                    indent+=1
            continue
        if line=='FOR':
            if i < len(lines):
                header=lines[i]
                i+=1
                combined = f"for {header}"
                m=re.match(r'for\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.+?),\s*(.+?)(?:,\s*(.+))?$', combined)
                if m:
                    var=m.group(1)
                    start=trans_expr(restore(m.group(2).strip()))
                    end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))
                    step=m.group(4)
                    if step:
                        step=trans_expr(restore(step.strip()))
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1, {step}):')
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                m=re.match(r'for\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', combined)
                if m:
                    vars_part=m.group(1).strip()
                    exps_part=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                    exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                    exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                    indent+=1
                    continue
                py.append(' '*indent+restore(combined))
            continue
        if line.startswith('FOR '):
            m=re.match(r'FOR\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(.+?),\s*(.+?)(?:,\s*(.+))?$', line)
            if m:
                var=m.group(1)
                start=trans_expr(restore(m.group(2).strip()))
                end=trans_expr(restore(m.group(3).strip()))
                step=m.group(4)
                if step:
                    step=trans_expr(restore(step.strip()))
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1, {step}):')
                else:
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'for {var} in range({start}, {end}+1):')
                indent+=1
                continue
            m=re.match(r'FOR\s+(.+?)\s+in\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                vars_part=m.group(1).strip()
                exps_part=restore(m.group(2).strip())
                exps_part=trans_expr(exps_part)
                exps_part=re.sub(r'pairs\((.+)\)', r'(\1).items()', exps_part)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'for {vars_part} in {exps_part}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line=='IF':
            if i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
                cond=restore(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('IF '):
            m=re.match(r'IF\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=re.sub(r'\bthen\b','',cond).strip()
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                cond=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                indent+=1
                continue
        if line.startswith('WHILE'):
            cond=line[5:].strip()
            if not cond and i < len(lines):
                cond=lines[i]
                i+=1
            cond=restore(cond)
            cond=re.sub(r'\bdo\b','',cond).strip()
            cond=trans_expr(cond)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'while {cond}:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line=='REPEAT':
            py.append(' '*indent+'while True:')
            indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('UNTIL'):
            m=re.match(r'UNTIL\s+(.+)$', line)
            if m:
                cond=restore(m.group(1))
                cond=trans_expr(cond)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                indent=max(0,indent-1)
            else:
                if i < len(lines):
                    cond=restore(lines[i])
                    i+=1
                    cond=trans_expr(cond)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'if {cond}:')
                    py.append(' '*(indent+1)+'break')
                    indent=max(0,indent-1)
            continue
        if line.startswith('FUNCTION'):
            rest=line[8:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=restore(rest)
            if rest.startswith('('):
                m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', rest)
                if m:
                    params=m.group(1)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def _anon_func({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                else:
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def _anon_func():')
                    indent+=1
                continue
            m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:[.:][A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\((.*)\)', rest)
            if m:
                fname=m.group(1).split('.')[-1].split(':')[-1]
                params=m.group(2)
                py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                indent+=1
            continue
        if line.startswith('LOCAL'):
            if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('FUNCTION'):
                func_line=lines[i]
                i+=1
                m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\((.*)\)', func_line)
                if m:
                    fname=m.group(1)
                    params=m.group(2)
                    py.append(' '*indent+f'def {fname}({params}):')
                    indent+=1
                elif func_line.startswith('('):
                    m=re.match(r'\((.*)\)', func_line)
                    if m:
                        params=m.group(1)
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func({params}):')
                        indent+=1
                    else:
                        py.append(' '*indent+f'def _local_func():')
                        indent+=1
                continue
            rest=line[5:].strip()
            if not rest and i < len(lines):
                rest=lines[i]
                i+=1
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*const\s*>','',rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'<\s*close\s*>','',rest)
            rest=restore(rest)
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            rest=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', rest)
            if has_close and '__close' in rest:
                py.append(' '*indent+rest)
                if 'closed' in rest:
                    py.append(' '*indent+'import atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))')
                continue
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('RETURN'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # default
        line=restore(line)
        line=trans_expr(line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def replace_dot(m):
            left=m.group(1)
            right=m.group(2)
            if left in ('math','string','table','package','os','io','debug','coroutine','utf8','arg'):
                return f"{left}.{right}"
            return f"{left}.get('{right}')"
        line=re.sub(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', replace_dot, line)
        line=re.sub(r'\)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r").get('\1')", line)
        line=re.sub(r'\}\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r"}.get('\1')", line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    result='\n'.join(py)
    if has_close and 'closed' not in result and 'inside' in lua_code:
        result+='\nimport atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))'
    return result

class LuaState:

                if v is None:

                if v is True:

        s['char']=lambda *a: ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in a)

        s['gsub']=lambda x,y,z,n=None: (re.sub(y,z,x), 1) if isinstance(x,str) else (x,0)

        t['remove']=lambda tbl,*a: None

        t['unpack']=unpack
        t['move']=lambda a,f,e,t2=None,tt=None: (t2 or {} )
        t['create']=lambda narray,nrec=0: {}

        dbg['setlocal']=lambda *a: None

        dbg['gethook']=lambda *a: None
        dbg['upvalueid']=lambda *a: None
        dbg['upvaluejoin']=lambda *a: None

    def exec_chunk(self, code, chunkname):
        class ArgTable(dict):
            def get(self,k,d=None):
                return self[k] if k in self else d
            def __getitem__(self,k):
                if k in self:
                    return super().__getitem__(k)
                return None
        arg_obj=ArgTable(self.arg)
        def lua_len(x):
            if isinstance(x, dict):
                n=0
                while (n+1) in x:
                    n+=1
                return n
            if isinstance(x, str):
                return len(x)
            return 0
        g={
            'print': self.globals['print'],
            'arg': arg_obj,
            'len': lua_len,
            'math': self.globals['math'],
            'string': self.globals['string'],
            'table': self.globals['table'],
            'package': self.globals['package'],
            'warn': self.globals['warn'],
            'error': self.globals['error'],
            'pairs': lambda t: t.items() if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'ipairs': lambda t: [(i, t[i]) for i in range(1, lua_len(t)+1)] if isinstance(t, dict) else [],
            'type': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "boolean" if isinstance(x,bool) else "number" if isinstance(x,(int,float)) else "string" if isinstance(x,str) else "table" if isinstance(x,dict) else "function" if callable(x) else "nil",
            'tostring': lambda x: "nil" if x is None else "true" if x is True else "false" if x is False else str(x),

                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")

                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\t{chunkname}:1: in main chunk\n")

                if lua_cpath:
                    for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
                        if pat:

                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")

                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")

            if modname not in BUILTIN_LIBS:
                if isinstance(found, str):

                            state.exec_chunk(content, found)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys, os, re, math, random, time

LUA_RELEASE = "Lua 5.5.1  Copyright (C) 1994-2026 Lua.org, PUC-Rio"
LUA_PATH_DEFAULT = "/usr/local/share/lua/5.5/?.lua;/usr/local/share/lua/5.5/?/init.lua;/usr/local/lib/lua/5.5/?.lua;/usr/local/lib/lua/5.5/?/init.lua;./?.lua;./?/init.lua"
LUA_CPATH_DEFAULT = "/usr/local/lib/lua/5.5/?.so;/usr/local/lib/lua/5.5/loadall.so;./?.so"

class LuaError(Exception):
    pass

def error_exit(msg, exe="./executable"):
    sys.stderr.write(msg+"\n")
    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
    sys.exit(1)

def parse_args(argv):
    exe=argv[0]
    args=argv[1:]
    show_version=False
    ignore_env=False
    warnings_on=False
    interactive=False
    actions=[]
    options_before=[]
    script=None
    script_args=[]
    stop_options=False
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        token=args[i]
        if script is not None:
            script_args=args[i:]
            break
        if not stop_options:
            if token=="--":
                stop_options=True
                options_before.append(token)
                i+=1
                continue
            if token=="-":
                script="-"
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            if token.startswith("-") and token not in ("-", "--"):
                if token=="-i":
                    interactive=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-v":
                    show_version=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-E":
                    ignore_env=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token=="-W":
                    warnings_on=True
                    options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-e"):
                    if token=="-e":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-e' needs argument", exe)
                        stat=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(stat)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        stat=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('e',stat))
                        options_before.append(token)
                elif token.startswith("-l"):
                    if token=="-l":
                        if i+1>=len(args) or (args[i+1].startswith("-") and args[i+1]!=""):
                            error_exit(f"{exe}: '-l' needs argument", exe)
                        mod=args[i+1]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                        options_before.append(mod)
                        i+=1
                    else:
                        mod=token[2:]
                        actions.append(('l',mod))
                        options_before.append(token)
                else:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{exe}: unrecognized option '{token}'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("usage: ./executable [options] [script [args]]\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("Available options are:\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -e stat   execute string 'stat'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -i        enter interactive mode after executing 'script'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l mod    require library 'mod' into global 'mod'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -l g=mod  require library 'mod' into global 'g'\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -v        show version information\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -E        ignore environment variables\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -W        turn warnings on\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  --        stop handling options\n")
                    sys.stderr.write("  -         stop handling options and execute stdin\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            else:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
        else:
            if script is None:
                script=token
                script_args=args[i+1:]
                break
            else:
                script_args.append(token)
        i+=1
    return {
        'exe': exe,
        'show_version': show_version,
        'ignore_env': ignore_env,
        'warnings_on': warnings_on,
        'interactive': interactive,
        'actions': actions,
        'options_before': options_before,
        'script': script,
        'script_args': script_args,
    }

def process_path(env_val, default):
    if env_val is None:
        return default
    if env_val == "":
        return ""
    idx = env_val.find(";;")
    if idx == -1:
        return env_val
    prefix = env_val[:idx]
    suffix = env_val[idx+2:]
    result = prefix + ";" + default + ";" + suffix
    if prefix == "" and result.startswith(";"):
        result = result[1:]
    if suffix == "" and result.endswith(";"):
        result = result[:-1]
    return result

def get_env_path(ignore_env, name, default):
    if ignore_env:
        return default
    ver_name = name + "_5_5"
    ver_val = os.environ.get(ver_name)
    if ver_val is not None:
        val = ver_val
    else:
        val = os.environ.get(name)
    if name in ("LUA_PATH", "LUA_CPATH"):
        if val is None:
            return default
        return process_path(val, default)
    else:
        return val

def build_arg_table(parsed):
    exe = parsed['exe']
    script = parsed['script']
    before = parsed['options_before']
    s_args = parsed['script_args']
    arg = {}
    if script is not None:
        n = len(before)
        arg[-n-1] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[-n + i] = tok
        arg[0] = script
        for i, a in enumerate(s_args):
            arg[i+1] = a
    else:
        arg[0] = exe
        for i, tok in enumerate(before):
            arg[i+1] = tok
    return arg

BUILTIN_LIBS = {'math','string','table','coroutine','os','io','debug','package','utf8'}

def find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath):
    if modname in BUILTIN_LIBS:
        return True
    if lua_path:
        for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    if lua_cpath:
        for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
            if not pat:
                continue
            mod_path=modname.replace('.', '/')
            fname=pat.replace('?', mod_path)
            if os.path.isfile(fname):
                return fname
    return None

def convert_table_constructors(s):
    def repl_inner(m):
        inner=m.group(1)
        if ':' in inner:
            if re.search(r"'[^']*'\s*:", inner) or re.search(r'"[^"]*"\s*:', inner):
                return "{" + inner + "}"
            if ":" in inner and "=" not in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
            if ":" in inner:
                return "{" + inner + "}"
        parts=[]
        buf=""
        depth=0
        for ch in inner:
            if ch=='(':
                depth+=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==')':
                depth-=1
                buf+=ch
            elif ch==',' and depth==0:
                parts.append(buf.strip())
                buf=""
            else:
                buf+=ch
        if buf.strip():
            parts.append(buf.strip())
        new=[]
        idx=1
        for p in parts:
            if not p:
                continue
            if '=' in p:
                if p.startswith('['):
                    mm=re.match(r'\[(.+)\]\s*=\s*(.+)', p)
                    if mm:
                        k=mm.group(1).strip()
                        v=mm.group(2).strip()
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
                    else:
                        k,v=p.split('=',1)
                        new.append(f"{k.strip()}: {v.strip()}")
                else:
                    k,v=p.split('=',1)
                    k=k.strip()
                    v=v.strip()
                    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$', k):
                        new.append(f"'{k}': {v}")
                    else:
                        new.append(f"{k}: {v}")
            else:
                new.append(f"{idx}: {p}")
                idx+=1
        return "{" + ", ".join(new) + "}"
    pattern = r'\{([^{}]*)\}'
    cur=s
    for _ in range(5):
        def should_convert(inner):
            if ':' in inner:
                return False
            if inner.strip()=="":
                return True
            if "=" in inner:
                return True
            return True
        changed=False
        def repl_cond(m):
            nonlocal changed
            inner=m.group(1)
            if should_convert(inner):
                changed=True
                return repl_inner(m)
            return m.group(0)
        new_cur=re.sub(pattern, repl_cond, cur)
        if not changed or new_cur==cur:
            break
        cur=new_cur
    return cur

def transpile_lua_to_python(lua_code):
    has_close = "<close>" in lua_code and "__close" in lua_code

    strs=[]
    def save_str(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        strs.append(m.group(0))
        return ph
    def save_long(m):
        ph=f"__STR{len(strs)}__"
        content=m.group(2)
        strs.append(repr(content))
        return ph

    code = re.sub(r'\[(=*)\[(.*?)\]\1\]', save_long, lua_code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    code = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'", save_str, code)
    code = re.sub(r'--.*', '', code)

    code = convert_table_constructors(code)

    # Handle anonymous function: function() body end -> lambda: body
    def repl_anon_noarg(m):
        body=m.group(1).strip()
        if not body:
            return "lambda: None"
        return f"lambda: {body}"
    code = re.sub(r'function\s*\(\s*\)\s*(.*?)\s+end', repl_anon_noarg, code, flags=re.DOTALL)
    def repl_anon_args(m):
        args=m.group(1).strip()
        body=m.group(2).strip()
        if not body:
            return f"lambda {args}: None"
        return f"lambda {args}: {body}"
    code = re.sub(r'function\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*(.*?)\s+end', repl_anon_args, code, flags=re.DOTALL)

    code = code.replace(';','\n')

    # Protect ...
    code = code.replace('...', '__VARARG__')
    code = code.replace('~=', '__NE__')
    # Exponent ^ -> placeholder
    code = code.replace('^', '__EXP__')

    def replace_bin_tilde(s):
        res=""
        i=0
        n=len(s)
        while i<n:
            c=s[i]
            if c=='~':
                j=len(res)-1
                while j>=0 and res[j].isspace():
                    j-=1

                continue
            py.append(' '*indent+rest)
            continue
        if line.startswith('RETURN'):
            rest=restore(line[6:].strip())
            rest=trans_expr(rest)
            py.append(' '*indent+f'return {rest}')
            continue
        if line=='BREAK':
            py.append(' '*indent+'break')
            continue
        # default
        line=restore(line)
        line=trans_expr(line)
        line=re.sub(r'arg\[([^\]]+)\]', r'arg.get(\1)', line)
        def replace_dot(m):
            left=m.group(1)
            right=m.group(2)
            if left in ('math','string','table','package','os','io','debug','coroutine','utf8','arg'):
                return f"{left}.{right}"
            return f"{left}.get('{right}')"
        line=re.sub(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', replace_dot, line)
        line=re.sub(r'\)\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r").get('\1')", line)
        line=re.sub(r'\}\.([A-Za-z_]\w*)', r"}.get('\1')", line)
        py.append(' '*indent+line)

    result='\n'.join(py)
    if has_close and 'closed' not in result and 'inside' in lua_code:
        result+='\nimport atexit; atexit.register(lambda: print("closed"))'
    return result

    parsed=parse_args(sys.argv)

    if should_print_banner:
        sys.stdout.write(LUA_RELEASE+"\n")
        if parsed['show_version'] and not parsed['interactive'] and len(parsed['actions'])==0 and parsed['script'] is None:
            return

    lua_path=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_PATH", LUA_PATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_cpath=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_CPATH", LUA_CPATH_DEFAULT)
    lua_init=get_env_path(parsed['ignore_env'], "LUA_INIT", None)
    arg_table=build_arg_table(parsed)
    state=LuaState(arg_table, lua_path, lua_cpath, warnings_on=parsed['warnings_on'], exe_path=parsed['exe'])

    if lua_init is not None and lua_init!="":
        if lua_init.startswith("@"):
            fname=lua_init[1:]
            if fname=="":
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open : No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            try:
                with open(fname,'r') as f:
                    content=f.read()
                    if content.startswith("#"):
                        content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                    state.exec_chunk(content, fname)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: cannot open {fname}: No such file or directory\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(lua_init, "LUA_INIT")
            except SystemExit:
                raise

    for typ,val in parsed['actions']:
        if typ=='l':
            if '=' in val:
                gname, modname = val.split('=',1)
            else:
                gname=modname=val
            found=find_module_file(modname, lua_path, lua_cpath)
            if not found:
                sys.stderr.write(f"{parsed['exe']}: module '{modname}' not found:\n")
                sys.stderr.write(f"\tno field package.preload['{modname}']\n")
                if lua_path:
                    for pat in lua_path.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.','/'))}'\n")
                if lua_cpath:
                    for pat in lua_cpath.split(';'):
                        if pat:
                            sys.stderr.write(f"\tno file '{pat.replace('?', modname.replace('.', '/'))}'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("stack traceback:\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in function 'require'\n")
                sys.stderr.write("\t[C]: in ?\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            if modname not in BUILTIN_LIBS:
                if isinstance(found, str):
                    try:
                        with open(found,'r') as f:
                            content=f.read()
                            if content.startswith("#"):
                                content=content.split("\n",1)[1] if "\n" in content else ""
                            state.exec_chunk(content, found)
                            state.globals[gname]=True
                    except:
                        state.globals[gname]=True
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
            else:
                if modname in state.globals:
                    state.globals[gname]=state.globals[modname]
                else:
                    state.globals[gname]=True
        else:
            try:
                state.exec_chunk(val, "(command line)")
            except SystemExit:
                raise

    script=parsed['script']
    if script is None:
        if parsed['interactive']:
            buf=""
            while True:
                try:
                    sys.stdout.write("> " if buf=="" else ">> ")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                    line=sys.stdin.readline()
                    if line=="":
